lines.text: Here's a small Python project with one failing test.
lines.caption: Here's a small Python project with one failing test.

lines.text: We set up an L L M agent, a program that lets a model work on a task step by step, and asked it to fix the test, twice.
lines.caption: We set up an LLM agent, a program that lets a model work on a task step by step, and asked it to fix the test, twice.

lines.text: Same model, same files, same task.
lines.caption: Same model, same files, same task.

lines.text: And both runs began the same way.
lines.caption: And both runs began the same way.

lines.text: They listed the files, read the test, read the code, and fixed the same bug.
lines.caption: They listed the files, read the test, read the code, and fixed the same bug.

lines.text: Then they split.
lines.caption: Then they split.

lines.text: Run A took four more steps.
lines.caption: Run A took four more steps.

lines.text: Its last reply began "Fixed", and ended "All tests now pass."
lines.caption: Its last reply began "Fixed", and ended "All tests now pass."

lines.text: Run B stopped right there.
lines.caption: Run B stopped right there.

lines.text: Its reply also began "Fixed", and said its code now matched the values the test expects.
lines.caption: Its reply also began "Fixed", and said its code now matched the values the test expects.

lines.text: So we ran the test ourselves.
lines.caption: So we ran the test ourselves.

lines.text: After run A, it passes.
lines.caption: After run A, it passes.

lines.text: After run B, it still fails.
lines.caption: After run B, it still fails.

lines.text: That wasn't luck.
lines.caption: That wasn't luck.

lines.text: We ran each version three times.
lines.caption: We ran each version three times.

lines.text: Every run like A passed.
lines.caption: Every run like A passed.

lines.text: Every run like B said "Fixed", and failed.
lines.caption: Every run like B said "Fixed", and failed.

lines.text: Run B was missing one thing: a way to run the test.
lines.caption: Run B was missing one thing: a way to run the test.

lines.text: The model was the same.
lines.caption: The model was the same.

lines.text: So what is an L L M agent, that taking away one tool leaves it sure of something false?
lines.caption: So what is an LLM agent, that taking away one tool leaves it sure of something false?

lines.text: To see what's going on, build it up from the start: a model on its own.
lines.caption: To see what's going on, build it up from the start: a model on its own.

lines.text: An L L M reads text and writes text.
lines.caption: An LLM reads text and writes text.

lines.text: You send it some, and it writes what comes next.
lines.caption: You send it some, and it writes what comes next.

lines.text: Everything it reads on one call is called its context.
lines.caption: Everything it reads on one call is called its context.

lines.text: Here, that's some instructions and our task.
lines.caption: Here, that's some instructions and our task.

lines.text: We reach the model through Claude's command-line tool, with that tool's own tools switched off, so text is all it can give back.
lines.caption: We reach the model through Claude's command-line tool, with that tool's own tools switched off, so text is all it can give back.

lines.text: It replies with text, of course.
lines.caption: It replies with text, of course.

lines.text: It even writes out a shell command it would like to run.
lines.caption: It even writes out a shell command it would like to run.

lines.text: But nothing runs text.
lines.caption: But nothing runs text.

lines.text: The command never ran, the model never saw a single file, and the test still fails.
lines.caption: The command never ran, the model never saw a single file, and the test still fails.

lines.text: For anything to change, something else has to act on what the model writes.
lines.caption: For anything to change, something else has to act on what the model writes.

lines.text: So let's act for it.
lines.caption: So let's act for it.

lines.text: We add a list of tools to the instructions: list the files, read a file, write a file, and run the tests.
lines.caption: We add a list of tools to the instructions: list the files, read a file, write a file, and run the tests.

lines.text: Each is ordinary code, written by us.
lines.caption: Each is ordinary code, written by us.

lines.text: We also tell the model how to ask for one: reply with one line of jay-son that names the tool.
lines.caption: We also tell the model how to ask for one: reply with one line of JSON that names the tool.

lines.text: That message is called a tool call.
lines.caption: That message is called a tool call.

lines.text: Now the model's first reply is a tool call: list the files.
lines.caption: Now the model's first reply is a tool call: list the files.

lines.text: Our code reads the tool call, runs the tool, and adds its output to the context.
lines.caption: Our code reads the tool call, runs the tool, and adds its output to the context.

lines.text: That's the tool result.
lines.caption: That's the tool result.

lines.text: Notice who ran it.
lines.caption: Notice who ran it.

lines.text: Not the model.
lines.caption: Not the model.

lines.text: It only asked.
lines.caption: It only asked.

lines.text: Anthropic's documentation puts it plainly: the model never executes anything on its own.
lines.caption: Anthropic's documentation puts it plainly: the model never executes anything on its own.

lines.text: Then we call the model again, and it asks for a second tool: read the test.
lines.caption: Then we call the model again, and it asks for a second tool: read the test.

lines.text: But our code stops here.
lines.caption: But our code stops here.

lines.text: It was written for one tool call.
lines.caption: It was written for one tool call.

lines.text: The model can't know in advance how many steps it will need.
lines.caption: The model can't know in advance how many steps it will need.

lines.text: So our code shouldn't decide that either.
lines.caption: So our code shouldn't decide that either.

lines.text: Therefore, a loop.
lines.caption: Therefore, a loop.

lines.text: Call the model.
lines.caption: Call the model.

lines.text: If its reply is a tool call, run the tool, and add the result to the context.
lines.caption: If its reply is a tool call, run the tool, and add the result to the context.

lines.text: Then call the model again.
lines.caption: Then call the model again.

lines.text: Stop when it replies without a tool call, or after twenty calls, in case it never does.
lines.caption: Stop when it replies without a tool call, or after twenty calls, in case it never does.

lines.text: That loop, with a model and some tools, is an agent.
lines.caption: That loop, with a model and some tools, is an agent.

lines.text: One common definition says just that: an L L M agent runs tools in a loop to achieve a goal.
lines.caption: One common definition says just that: an LLM agent runs tools in a loop to achieve a goal.

lines.text: Here's run A, one call at a time.
lines.caption: Here's run A, one call at a time.

lines.text: It lists the files, reads the test, and reads the code.
lines.caption: It lists the files, reads the test, and reads the code.

lines.text: And it spots a bug: the code adds the units to the price, where it should multiply them.
lines.caption: And it spots a bug: the code adds the units to the price, where it should multiply them.

lines.text: It rewrites that line, then asks to run the test.
lines.caption: It rewrites that line, then asks to run the test.

lines.text: Pause here, and make a prediction.
lines.caption: Pause here, and make a prediction.

lines.text: The model found a real bug, and fixed it.
lines.caption: The model found a real bug, and fixed it.

lines.text: Will the test pass?
lines.caption: Will the test pass?

lines.text: It doesn't.
lines.caption: It doesn't.

lines.text: The test fails with a key error: there's no column called "region".
lines.caption: The test fails with a key error: there's no column called "region".

lines.text: That result goes into the context, like any other.
lines.caption: That result goes into the context, like any other.

lines.text: It's the world's answer, not the model's guess: what Anthropic's guide to agents calls ground truth.
lines.caption: It's the world's answer, not the model's guess: what Anthropic's guide to agents calls ground truth.

lines.text: And on the next call, the model reads it, and changes course: it asks to see the data file.
lines.caption: And on the next call, the model reads it, and changes course: it asks to see the data file.

lines.text: The file begins with an invisible character, called a byte order mark, glued to the front of the word "region".
lines.caption: The file begins with an invisible character, called a byte order mark, glued to the front of the word "region".

lines.text: The code was only half the problem.
lines.caption: The code was only half the problem.

lines.text: The model changes how the file is opened, so the mark is skipped.
lines.caption: The model changes how the file is opened, so the mark is skipped.

lines.text: It runs the test again, and this time it passes.
lines.caption: It runs the test again, and this time it passes.

lines.text: Then it replies with no tool call, and the loop ends.
lines.caption: Then it replies with no tool call, and the loop ends.

lines.text: Notice who decided to look at the data file.
lines.caption: Notice who decided to look at the data file.

lines.text: Not our code: it only ran what was asked.
lines.caption: Not our code: it only ran what was asked.

lines.text: Nobody wrote that step in advance.
lines.caption: Nobody wrote that step in advance.

lines.text: Suppose we had scripted the steps instead: read, then fix, then test.
lines.caption: Suppose we had scripted the steps instead: read, then fix, then test.

lines.text: That kind of program is called a workflow.
lines.caption: That kind of program is called a workflow.

lines.text: Ours would have stopped at the key error, with no step for what came next.
lines.caption: Ours would have stopped at the key error, with no step for what came next.

lines.text: In an agent, the model picks each next step from what's in its context.
lines.caption: In an agent, the model picks each next step from what's in its context.

lines.text: Here, that included ground truth from the test.
lines.caption: Here, that included ground truth from the test.

lines.text: Run A called the model nine times: eight tool calls, then the final reply.
lines.caption: Run A called the model nine times: eight tool calls, then the final reply.

lines.text: It looks as if the model worked through the problem, remembering what it had tried.
lines.caption: It looks as if the model worked through the problem, remembering what it had tried.

lines.text: It didn't.
lines.caption: It didn't.

lines.text: Each of those calls started from nothing.
lines.caption: Each of those calls started from nothing.

lines.text: The model keeps nothing between calls.
lines.caption: The model keeps nothing between calls.

lines.text: So our loop sends it the whole context every time: the instructions, the task, and every tool call and result so far.
lines.caption: So our loop sends it the whole context every time: the instructions, the task, and every tool call and result so far.

lines.text: Here's how much it read on each call, counted in tokens, the chunks of text a model reads.
lines.caption: Here's how much it read on each call, counted in tokens, the chunks of text a model reads.

lines.text: The first call read about fourteen hundred.
lines.caption: The first call read about fourteen hundred.

lines.text: Most of that is fixed text: our instructions, and notes that the command-line tool we call the model through adds to every call.
lines.caption: Most of that is fixed text: our instructions, and notes that the command-line tool we call the model through adds to every call.

lines.text: The ninth read about twenty-seven hundred: everything the first call read, and everything since.
lines.caption: The ninth read about twenty-seven hundred: everything the first call read, and everything since.

lines.text: Together, the nine calls read about eighteen and a half thousand tokens, to change two lines of code.
lines.caption: Together, the nine calls read about eighteen and a half thousand tokens, to change two lines of code.

lines.text: This isn't a quirk of our code.
lines.caption: This isn't a quirk of our code.

lines.text: Anthropic's documentation says the same of its Messages A P I: it's stateless, so every request carries the whole context again.
lines.caption: Anthropic's documentation says the same of its Messages API: it's stateless, so every request carries the whole context again.

lines.text: The model still knows what it learned in training.
lines.caption: The model still knows what it learned in training.

lines.text: That's how it knew what a byte order mark was.
lines.caption: That's how it knew what a byte order mark was.

lines.text: But what it has tried in this task, and what came back, it knows only from its context.
lines.caption: But what it has tried in this task, and what came back, it knows only from its context.

lines.text: The context is its only memory of the task.
lines.caption: The context is its only memory of the task.

lines.text: Now run B makes sense.
lines.caption: Now run B makes sense.

lines.text: It's the same loop and the same model.
lines.caption: It's the same loop and the same model.

lines.text: The only difference is the tool list: there's no run tests.
lines.caption: The only difference is the tool list: there's no run tests.

lines.text: Its first four steps match run A's.
lines.caption: Its first four steps match run A's.

lines.text: Then, where run A asked to run the test, run B had nothing to ask for.
lines.caption: Then, where run A asked to run the test, run B had nothing to ask for.

lines.text: So it replied.
lines.caption: So it replied.

lines.text: Look at its context when it did: its own fix, and nothing after it.
lines.caption: Look at its context when it did: its own fix, and nothing after it.

lines.text: No tool result could have told it the fix was incomplete.
lines.caption: No tool result could have told it the fix was incomplete.

lines.text: It looks as if the model knew it had succeeded.
lines.caption: It looks as if the model knew it had succeeded.

lines.text: It didn't.
lines.caption: It didn't.

lines.text: It only knew that nothing in its context said otherwise.
lines.caption: It only knew that nothing in its context said otherwise.

lines.text: Its "Fixed" wasn't a lie.
lines.caption: Its "Fixed" wasn't a lie.

lines.text: It was a reasonable conclusion, from a context with no evidence against it.
lines.caption: It was a reasonable conclusion, from a context with no evidence against it.

lines.text: It could have read the data file.
lines.caption: It could have read the data file.

lines.text: It had the tool.
lines.caption: It had the tool.

lines.text: It just didn't see a reason to.
lines.caption: It just didn't see a reason to.

lines.text: So this is why agents work, and the first way they break down.
lines.caption: So this is why agents work, and the first way they break down.

lines.text: Each step can put ground truth into the context.
lines.caption: Each step can put ground truth into the context.

lines.text: Where nothing checks the work, the model's own guess has the last word.
lines.caption: Where nothing checks the work, the model's own guess has the last word.

lines.text: If that guess were one step in a longer task, the next call would read it as fact and build on it.
lines.caption: If that guess were one step in a longer task, the next call would read it as fact and build on it.

lines.text: Nothing here would catch that either.
lines.caption: Nothing here would catch that either.

lines.text: It's called compounding errors.
lines.caption: It's called compounding errors.

lines.text: Would a more capable model do better?
lines.caption: Would a more capable model do better?

lines.text: We gave run B's setup to one, three times.
lines.caption: We gave run B's setup to one, three times.

lines.text: Twice, with no way to run the test, it read the data file to check the sums by hand.
lines.caption: Twice, with no way to run the test, it read the data file to check the sums by hand.

lines.text: It found the mark, and fixed both bugs.
lines.caption: It found the mark, and fixed both bugs.

lines.text: And it said plainly that it couldn't run the test.
lines.caption: And it said plainly that it couldn't run the test.

lines.text: It did better the same way run A did: it put more ground truth into its own context.
lines.caption: It did better the same way run A did: it put more ground truth into its own context.

lines.text: The third time, it asked for the data file in a format our code didn't recognise.
lines.caption: The third time, it asked for the data file in a format our code didn't recognise.

lines.text: Our loop saw no tool call, took the reply as final, and stopped.
lines.caption: Our loop saw no tool call, took the reply as final, and stopped.

lines.text: That failure wasn't the model's.
lines.caption: That failure wasn't the model's.

lines.text: It's chapter three again: the model can only ask, and our code decides what counts as asking, and what counts as done.
lines.caption: It's chapter three again: the model can only ask, and our code decides what counts as asking, and what counts as done.

lines.text: The code around the model isn't plumbing.
lines.caption: The code around the model isn't plumbing.

lines.text: The second way agents break down is in the staircase.
lines.caption: The second way agents break down is in the staircase.

lines.text: In a loop like ours, the context only grows.
lines.caption: In a loop like ours, the context only grows.

lines.text: Every step adds to it, and every call reads all of it.
lines.caption: Every step adds to it, and every call reads all of it.

lines.text: Here's the same task, run once by Claude Code, Anthropic's coding agent.
lines.caption: Here's the same task, run once by Claude Code, Anthropic's coding agent.

lines.text: It's the same command-line tool we've been calling the model through, now running its own loop, with its tools narrowed to match ours: read, edit, and run the test.
lines.caption: It's the same command-line tool we've been calling the model through, now running its own loop, with its tools narrowed to match ours: read, edit, and run the test.

lines.text: Its first call read about eleven thousand six hundred tokens: its instructions, its tool descriptions, and our task.
lines.caption: Its first call read about eleven thousand six hundred tokens: its instructions, its tool descriptions, and our task.

lines.text: It found both bugs in nine calls, like run A.
lines.caption: It found both bugs in nine calls, like run A.

lines.text: But it read those instructions again on every call, so in all it read over a hundred and twenty thousand tokens.
lines.caption: But it read those instructions again on every call, so in all it read over a hundred and twenty thousand tokens.

lines.text: And a longer task means more reading than its length suggests.
lines.caption: And a longer task means more reading than its length suggests.

lines.text: Each new call re-reads everything before it, so twice the calls means more than twice the reading.
lines.caption: Each new call re-reads everything before it, so twice the calls means more than twice the reading.

lines.text: The reading has a price beyond time.
lines.caption: The reading has a price beyond time.

lines.text: As a context grows, models get worse at recalling what's in it.
lines.caption: As a context grows, models get worse at recalling what's in it.

lines.text: Researchers call this context rot.
lines.caption: Researchers call this context rot.

lines.text: Our runs are far too short to show it.
lines.caption: Our runs are far too short to show it.

lines.text: Production agents, Claude Code among them, keep the context in check by summarizing it when it gets long.
lines.caption: Production agents, Claude Code among them, keep the context in check by summarizing it when it gets long.

lines.text: That's called compaction.
lines.caption: That's called compaction.

lines.text: But a summary is still the model's only memory.
lines.caption: But a summary is still the model's only memory.

lines.text: Whatever it leaves out, the model no longer knows.
lines.caption: Whatever it leaves out, the model no longer knows.

lines.text: So why did one missing tool leave run B sure of something false?
lines.caption: So why did one missing tool leave run B sure of something false?

lines.text: Because an agent is a model that picks each next step from its context, not from steps written in advance, as a workflow would.
lines.caption: Because an agent is a model that picks each next step from its context, not from steps written in advance, as a workflow would.

lines.text: And a loop that runs those steps, and writes the results back in.
lines.caption: And a loop that runs those steps, and writes the results back in.

lines.text: About the task, the model remembers nothing else.
lines.caption: About the task, the model remembers nothing else.

lines.text: Run A's context held ground truth from the test.
lines.caption: Run A's context held ground truth from the test.

lines.text: Run B's held only its own fix.
lines.caption: Run B's held only its own fix.

lines.text: Same model, different context.
lines.caption: Same model, different context.

lines.text: The more capable model did better in just that way: it read the data for itself.
lines.caption: The more capable model did better in just that way: it read the data for itself.

lines.text: And it said what it hadn't been able to check.
lines.caption: And it said what it hadn't been able to check.

lines.text: That's also why coding suits agents so well, as Anthropic's guide points out.
lines.caption: That's also why coding suits agents so well, as Anthropic's guide points out.

lines.text: Code comes with tests: an answer the agent can check its work against at every step.
lines.caption: Code comes with tests: an answer the agent can check its work against at every step.

lines.text: We've skipped a lot here: planning, memory that lasts between tasks, and teams of agents.
lines.caption: We've skipped a lot here: planning, memory that lasts between tasks, and teams of agents.

lines.text: But each of those still reaches the model the same way: through its context.
lines.caption: But each of those still reaches the model the same way: through its context.

lines.text: So when you build an agent, or hand one a task, don't only ask how clever the model is.
lines.caption: So when you build an agent, or hand one a task, don't only ask how clever the model is.

lines.text: Ask what will tell it that it's wrong.
lines.caption: Ask what will tell it that it's wrong.
